title: Castelion
description: Mid-century poster patriotism: a warm parchment-cream page with flag-navy headings and whole navy bands, one signal red for square button slabs, and a near-black ink card. A geometric Futura-style sans throughout, bold titles with a little tracking, justified medium body. 4px corners, no shadows: depth comes from layering, parallax and venetian-blind stripes.
notes: light is the faithful mode (the cream page); dark is a sibling with an ink-navy page
navy bands use the `dark` class with bg-secondary: .dark secondary is the flag navy and .dark background a deeper ink-navy, so bands stay distinct in dark mode
Jost stands in for Futura (commercial): an open Futura revival with the same geometric build and small x-height
the gutter is fluid: 18px on phones to 72px at 1440
